summary_en: On November 13, 2026, the board of directors resolved to cancel 1,140,615 ordinary shares, representing 28.40% of issued shares before cancellation. The cancellation is scheduled to take effect on December 30, 2026, reducing total issued shares to 2,874,970.
title_en: Notice regarding cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: Hiraga Co., Ltd. announced on November 13, 2026 that its board of directors has resolved to cancel 1,140,615 treasury ordinary shares, constituting 28.40% of issued shares prior to cancellation. The cancellation will take effect on December 30, 2026 in accordance with Article 178 of the Companies Act. Upon completion, the company's total issued share count will decrease to 2,874,970 shares.
